serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Ecclesiasticalot FF: I’m back. Are you two still at it?
You: I guess so.
You: What did you want to tell me, Shanice?
Shanice: L-let’s talk about it at a different time. 
You: Alright. I was about to go back home soon anyway. 
Shanice: And you should. You need to keep spoiling your girlfriend or she’s gonna dump you!
You: Don’t even joke like that…
Ecclesiasticalot FF: She’s right though. 
You: You guys keep coming up with some hurtful assumptions…
You: Anyway. See you later!
Shanice: You too!
Ecclesiasticalot FF: God be with you.
